verdict.rationale: The front-door probe found robots.txt open to every agent on the guidance pages, and only the /e-services/ transaction paths are disallowed, which are not part of the public reading surface. Quoted content was extracted from several guidance pages (/online/, /online/bus.htm, /bus/ct/article9a.htm, /bus/doingbus/hire.htm), and other probes returned plain HTTP 404s rather than challenge pages, so the reading surface is fetchable without keys and is not a JS-only shell. Missing for 10: an explicit probe result confirming no CAPTCHA or bot challenge for a named, identified user agent, and independent corroboration of keyless access.
